SELECT 
    o.total_amount AS order_amount,
    c.discount_amount AS discount_amount,
    c.discount_rate AS discount_rate,
    u.age AS user_age,
    p.category_id AS product_category
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    coupon c ON o.coupon_used = c.coupon_id
JOIN 
    users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN 
    sku s ON oi.sku_id = s.sku_id
JOIN 
    products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    o.total_amount IS NOT NULL
    AND c.discount_amount IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 100;
